label: AI analytics premium add-on (illustrative)
decisionQuestion: Should we build and launch AI-powered analytics as a premium add-on?

company.name: Example SaaS Co
company.productSummary: B2B workflow SaaS for mid-market teams; core product is project and ops tracking.
company.jobToBeDone: Track projects and operations in one workspace

feature.title: AI-powered analytics premium add-on
feature.description: Natural-language insights and anomaly detection on customer workspace data; sold as optional premium tier or per-seat add-on.

constraints.notes: Avoid broad SMB price pressure; prefer learning before full GA.

targetMarketBehavior: Mixed SMB and enterprise; enterprise cares about insights; SMB is price-sensitive.
crustdataSearchHint: B2B SaaS workflow software companies offering analytics or business intelligence for SMB and mid-market.

pilot.label: Enterprise validation pilot
pilot.scope: Offer beta analytics to up to 10 enterprise accounts (500+ employees); not available to SMB.
pilot.successCriterion: At least 3 of 10 accounts convert to paid add-on or expand contract within 8 weeks.
pilot.failCriterion: Fewer than 2 accounts activate weekly active usage by week 4.

broad_launch.label: Broad launch (all customers)
broad_launch.scope: GA to entire customer base (SMB + enterprise) after build complete.

delay.label: Delay 6 months
delay.scope: Defer build; revisit after core retention work.

do_not_build.label: Do not build
do_not_build.scope: Do not invest in this feature; focus on core product.

enterprise_segment_launch.label: Enterprise-only GA
enterprise_segment_launch.scope: Ship only to enterprise segment, not a time-boxed pilot.
